##### Decision Variables

Let $x_{ij} \geq 0$ be the continuous quantity shipped from distribution center (supplier) $i$ to customer group $j$.

Where:
- $i \in I = \{\text{S1}, \text{S2}, \ldots, \text{S18}\}$ (distribution centers, as listed in source order)
- $j \in J = \{\text{C1}, \text{C2}, \ldots, \text{C18}\}$ (customer groups, as listed in source order)

##### Parameters

- $d_j$: demand of customer $j$ (from column demand_units in customer_demand.csv)
- $s_i$: supply capacity of supplier $i$ (from column supply_capacity_units in supply_capacity.csv)
- $c_{ij}$: transportation cost per unit from supplier $i$ to customer $j$ (from column transportation_cost_to_Cj in transportation_costs.csv)

##### Objective Function

Minimize total transportation cost:
$$
\min \sum_{i \in I} \sum_{j \in J} c_{ij} x_{ij}
$$

##### Constraints

1. **Demand satisfaction:** For each customer $j \in J$,
   $$
   \sum_{i \in I} x_{ij} \geq d_j
   $$
2. **Supply capacity:** For each supplier $i \in I$,
   $$
   \sum_{j \in J} x_{ij} \leq s_i
   $$
3. **Non-negativity:** For all $i \in I$, $j \in J$,
   $$
   x_{ij} \geq 0
   $$

##### Sets

- $I = \{\text{S1}, \text{S2}, \ldots, \text{S18}\}$ (in source order)
- $J = \{\text{C1}, \text{C2}, \ldots, \text{C18}\}$ (in source order)

##### Complete Model

Minimize
$$
\sum_{i \in I} \sum_{j \in J} c_{ij} x_{ij}
$$

Subject to
$$
\sum_{i \in I} x_{ij} \geq d_j \quad \forall j \in J
$$
$$
\sum_{j \in J} x_{ij} \leq s_i \quad \forall i \in I
$$
$$
x_{ij} \geq 0 \quad \forall i \in I,\, j \in J
$$

All parameters and coefficients are as listed above, preserving all identifiers and source order.
